SELECT s.id, e.EventName as eventName, p.ItemName as itemName, a.Name as athleteName, s.score_value as scoreValue, s.score_rank as scoreRank, s.create_time as createTime FROM score s LEFT JOIN event e ON s.event_id = e.EventID LEFT JOIN eventitem p ON s.item_id = p.ItemID LEFT JOIN athlete a ON s.athlete_id = a.AthleteID
AND s.is_published = 1
AND e.EventName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{eventName}, '%')
ORDER BY e.EventID DESC, p.ItemID ASC, s.score_rank ASC
